name: Ebisu
tagline: Shibuya in 2 minutes and Roppongi in 6 minutes. Served by 4 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥150,000 to ¥160,000.
summary: The station is in Shibuya City, where JR East and Tokyo Metro run 4 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 22 minutes to Otemachi, 7 minutes to Shinjuku, 2 minutes to Shibuya and 19 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. The station stands 15.5 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 17.2 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 15.5 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 13.5 m to 30.7 m, a difference of 17.2 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 2 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is less than 0.5 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 14 clinics and 6 pharmacies. The nearest facility recorded as a hospital is 厚生中央病院, about 639 m from the station. The next nearest is 東京共済病院, about 795 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 4 lines serve the station. JR Yamanote Line and JR Saikyo Line run through it. JR Shonan-Shinjuku Line also call here. Tokyo Metro Hibiya Line are available too. The lines are split between operators (JR East runs 3 lines and Tokyo Metro runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: JR Saikyo Line runs at 167% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 板橋→池袋, which this station is not on. Tokyo Metro Hibiya Line runs at 163%. Its busiest stretch is 三ノ輪→入谷, which this station is likewise not on. JR Yamanote Line runs at 136%. Its busiest stretch is 新大久保→新宿, which this station is likewise not on. JR Shonan-Shinjuku Line is not covered by the ministry's congestion survey. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: One room ¥150,000 to ¥160,000, 1K ¥150,000 to ¥160,000, 1LDK ¥270,000 to ¥280,000 and 2LDK ¥400,000 to ¥410,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 10 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, very few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 4 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are some of the most heavily loaded in the morning.
